zh: 新增「WE✖️AI」提词器与演示材料自动翻页联动功能：基于 BroadcastChannel 与本地跨页通道，提词器按句滚动或换页时演示幻灯片自动同步翻页，支持双向联动与状态开关。
优化「WE✖️AI」峰会材料与提词脚本：第 7 页管理转型引入更自然的“这就把格局看小了”（That misses the bigger picture）；第 8 页精简科技巨头数字墙讲稿，突出 Palantir 与 OpenAI 40 亿美元等核心标杆，更新 Telstra 与 Verizon 的业务数据与好的 feedback 表达，PPT 视觉卡片保持完整详实。
优化桌面智能体（Codex / Claude Code / Antigravity / WorkBuddy）状态雷达交互、配额条展示与共享会话视图切换逻辑，修复从雷达图跳转桌面会话时的加载与视图联动；优化 Kindle 额度补采与 Antigravity CSRF 令牌自动发现。
en: Added real-time slide sync between WE✖️AI Teleprompter and Presentation Material: prompter scrolling and navigation automatically flip the presentation deck via cross-tab BroadcastChannel with toggleable sync mode.

Refined WE✖️AI presentation materials and prompter script: updated Slide 7 management transition to 'That misses the bigger picture', streamlined Big Tech numbers wall on Slide 8 to highlight Palantir and OpenAI ($4B) while keeping slide cards visually complete, and updated Telstra/Verizon metrics and feedback phrasing.

Enhanced Agent Status Radar navigation, desktop quota bar presentation, and shared conversation view management for desktop agents (Codex / Claude Code / Antigravity / WorkBuddy); polished Kindle quota sync and Antigravity server CSRF token discovery.
